name: hangup
description:
gvmd hangs up rather than replying when it rejects a command: a live gvmd 25.2.1 closes the socket immediately after answering a pre-authenticate command, and the next send fails with a broken pipe. This scenario points that behaviour at the importer's response framer -- the connection dies with no bytes delivered.

The framer reads through recv, which returns EMPTY bytes at EOF, rather than recv_until, which RAISES at EOF and used to abort the whole run with an opaque 'failed to call main function: recv_until: EOF'. A hangup must now surface as the framer's own printed error, mark the connection dead so nothing sends on it again, and end the run cleanly with zero assets -- which is exactly what this scenario asserts.  The framer still ends the run cleanly rather than aborting inside recv_until, but a connection that died mid-response leaves no inventory, so the task ends in error.

error_contains: connection closed before a complete response was read
